# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import socket
import sqlite3
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
assert root == Path("/home/jacob/hamon-capturesuite-7697-registry-migration")
assert os.getuid() == 1000 and root.stat().st_uid == 1000
packet = json.loads((root / "source-packet.json").read_text())
source_root = root / "source"
def git_blob(raw):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
guards = []
for item in packet["files"]:
    target = source_root / item["path"]
    assert not target.exists()
    raw = item["content"].encode()
    assert git_blob(raw) == item["sha"]
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(raw)
    guards.append({"path": item["path"], "blob": git_blob(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
sys.path.insert(0, str(source_root / "libs/python/capture_session"))
from capture_session import registry as module

database = root / "failed-first-migration.sqlite"
assert not database.exists()
original_sql = module._MIGRATIONS[1]
start = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
failed_registry = module.AppRegistry(database)
try:
    with patch.dict(module._MIGRATIONS, {1: original_sql + "\nSELECT unavailable_migration_hook();\n"}):
        failed_registry.open()
except sqlite3.OperationalError as error:
    failure = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
else:
    raise AssertionError("Injected migration failure was not reached")
finally:
    failed_registry.close()
with sqlite3.connect(database) as con:
    objects = [list(row) for row in con.execute("SELECT type, name FROM sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY type, name")]
    versions = con.execute("SELECT version FROM schema_migrations").fetchall() if any(row[1] == "schema_migrations" for row in objects) else []
retry = module.AppRegistry(database)
try:
    result = retry.open()
    retry_result = {"opened": True, "version": result.schema_version}
except sqlite3.OperationalError as error:
    retry_result = {"opened": False, "type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
finally:
    retry.close()
for item in packet["files"]:
    assert git_blob((source_root / item["path"]).read_bytes()) == item["sha"]
report = {
    "schema": "capturesuite.registry-migration-original-probe/1",
    "started_utc": start, "finished_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "repository": packet["repository"], "base": packet["base"],
    "environment": {"host": socket.gethostname(), "uid": os.getuid(), "python": platform.python_version(), "sqlite": sqlite3.sqlite_version, "platform": platform.platform(), "course": "Python 3.14 diagnostic; supported 3.12 receiving still required"},
    "failure": failure, "objects_after_failure": objects, "versions_after_failure": versions,
    "retry_original": retry_result,
    "source_guards": guards, "source_guards_unchanged": True,
    "migration_1_sha256": hashlib.sha256(original_sql.encode()).hexdigest(),
    "injected_suffix": "\nSELECT unavailable_migration_hook();\n",
    "limit": "Public open against a disposable SQLite database; injected SQL failure demonstrates transaction semantics, not actual disk exhaustion."
}
(root / "original-probe.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import platform
import socket
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
assert root == Path("/home/jacob/hamon-capturesuite-7697-registry-migration")
assert os.getuid() == 1000 and root.stat().st_uid == 1000
course = sys.argv[1]
assert course in {"original", "candidate"}
work = root / course
assert not work.exists()
work.mkdir()
source_packet = json.loads((root / "source-packet.json").read_text())
test_packet = json.loads((root / "test-packet.json").read_text())
def git_blob(raw):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
guards = []
for item in source_packet["files"] + test_packet["files"]:
    raw = item["content"].encode()
    if item.get("sha"):
        assert git_blob(raw) == item["sha"], item["path"]
    if course == "candidate" and item["path"].endswith("/registry.py"):
        raw = (root / "candidate-registry.py").read_bytes()
    target = work / item["path"]
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(raw)
    guards.append({"path": item["path"], "blob": git_blob(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
temporary = work / "tmp"
temporary.mkdir()
env = dict(os.environ)
env.update({"PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD": "1", "TMPDIR": str(temporary)})
command = [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "--tb=short", "-c", str(work / "pyproject.toml"), "--junitxml", str(work / "receiving.xml"),
           str(work / "tests/protocol/test_registry_migration_atomicity.py"), str(work / "tests/protocol/test_settings_registry.py"), str(work / "tests/protocol/test_registry_readonly_receiving.py")]
start = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
clock = time.monotonic()
result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=work, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
elapsed = time.monotonic() - clock
after = [{"path": item["path"], "blob": git_blob((work / item["path"]).read_bytes())} for item in guards]
unchanged = all(before["blob"] == received["blob"] for before, received in zip(guards, after, strict=True))
report = {"schema": "capturesuite.registry-migration-maintained/1", "repository": source_packet["repository"], "base": source_packet["base"], "course": course, "started_utc": start, "finished_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
          "environment": {"hostname": socket.gethostname(), "uid": os.getuid(), "python": platform.python_version(), "python_executable": sys.executable, "sqlite": sqlite3.sqlite_version, "pytest": importlib.metadata.version("pytest"), "platform": platform.platform(), "qualification": "Python 3.14 diagnostic; supported Python 3.12 independent receiving remains distinct"},
          "command": command, "cwd": str(work), "environment_overrides": {key: env[key] for key in ["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE", "PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD", "TMPDIR"]},
          "returncode": result.returncode, "elapsed_s": elapsed, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr, "junit": (work / "receiving.xml").read_text(),
          "source_guards": guards, "source_guards_after": after, "source_guards_unchanged": unchanged,
          "scope": "Four new regression cases plus nine unchanged settings/registry/read-only tests; exact project config and five-file package subset, without repository-wide conftest or desktop dependencies."}
(root / (course + "-maintained.json")).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({key: report[key] for key in ["course", "started_utc", "finished_utc", "returncode", "stdout", "stderr", "source_guards_unchanged"]}, indent=2))
assert unchanged
sys.exit(result.returncode)

native_capacity_event.recovery: A later read-only capacity check found space available. The exact prepared runner was then written once and completed with exit 0. No correctness/Ruff reruns were performed.
native_capacity_event.mac_fallback: Delivery received and statically verified the 17-file input packet; its Mac read route timed out before any license write/execution. Local ThinkPad recovery completed the gate.

limits: ThinkPad Python3.14.4 results are diagnostic; supported receiving is the independent Python3.12.8 macOS course.
Only the specified source package, tests and config were materialized; full repository tests, Windows UI/daemon/hardware, and installation were not run.
License checker passed on the explicitly listed package/test/license subset, not on a complete repository checkout.
Synthetic migration fixtures exercise real SQLite DDL/DML/receipt failure and retry; no real disk-exhaustion, process-crash or power-loss experiment was performed.
The correction prevents new partial migrations; it does not automatically repair databases already partially migrated by an older build.
Publication is an isolated branch plus issue handoff under the Actions hold; no PR or merge is requested.
